conservative.requirements: Charm, Guile, or Leadership Mastery. Enhances a Social action that uses one of those skills you have Mastery in. Special: Play this card when you perform a Social action. You may remove dice from your dice pool. If you do, you gain the bonuses listed this card for each die. You or your target recovers 1 stress. You or your target gains the Invigorated condition for 3 rounds. You and your target recover 1 stress. If both {Dm} and {Dc} have been invested in this Enhance, you both gain the Inspired condition for 3 rounds.

success.description: The target's action card he has recharging suffers 1 stress.

reckless.requirements: Persuade, Intimidate, or Skulduggery Mastery. Special: Play this card when you perform a Social action. You may remove dice from your dice pool. If you do, you gain the bonuses listed on this card for each die. Your target suffers 1 stress. Add 2 recharge tokens to one of the target's action cards. Then, the target suffers 1 stress per {Dm} invested in this Enhance.
